referenceBoundaryInstruction: Reference roles are exclusive. Ignore incidental pose, expression, background, layout and styling outside each assigned role.
multiViewInstruction: Use sheets and catalog images only as source evidence; output one continuous Scene frame, never a sheet, collage, split screen, inset or repeated person.
preserveOutfitInstruction: Preserve the approved Look and garment details while the current Shot controls pose, expression and action.
replaceOutfitInstruction: Replace source clothing only with the explicitly approved outfit reference while preserving Character identity and proportions.
narrativeBehaviorInstructions: Render an observed narrative moment, not a posed portrait or fashion presentation.
Keep natural asymmetry in shoulders, hands and weight; props belong to the action, with no direct camera gaze unless authored.
baselinePhotographicInstructions: Create one physically plausible live-action frame with readable Scene context, moderate depth separation and motivated available or practical light.
Keep believable falloff, contact shadows, reflections, scale and material response.

photorealistic-cinematic: Keep source-consistent unretouched skin, slight tonal variation, natural hair strands, garment weight, fabric weave and contact compression.
Allow subtle sensor noise, fine grain, slight optical softness, natural focus falloff, restrained highlight halation and minute lens imperfection.

constraintInstructions: No fashion or beauty posing or prop display; no glossy retouch, plastic skin, illustration or CGI, excessive HDR, artificial sharpness or exaggerated bokeh.
No duplicate people, copied sheet layout, impossible reflections or unauthorized objects.
